recipes.name: Grilled Peach Bruschetta
ingredients: ¾ cup plain vegan cream cheese
instructions: Bring a grill pan to medium-high heat. Then cook the peaches until deeply caramelized, around 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Set aside to cool down slightly.
Add the remaining bruschetta ingredients to a large bowl. Set aside.
Once cool enough to handle, dice the peaches.
Add them to the bowl and stir to combine. Set aside
Heat the oil in a grill pan over medium heat. Toast the bread slices until golden on both sides.
To assemble, spread the cream cheese on the toasted bread and top with the peach and tomato mixture. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Best enjoyed immediately. The bruschetta components can be stored in separate airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days.
